- None identified in this attempt - all changes were counterproductive

**Ineffective Changes:**
- Removing class weighting (all weights from 1.1→1.0)
- Increasing learning rate from 0.001 to 0.01
- The combination of these two changes

- Optimization direction: Focus on class-balanced data augmentation techniques to reduce reliance on class weighting.
- Reasoning: Since class weighting proved important for performance, augmenting underrepresented classes could provide similar benefits while making the model more robust to the original class distribution.
